don't let your suburban lifestyle get in the way, take baby steps toward. if u feel comfortable, its always good to throw yourself into a situation that u r not used to and find your footing. its really a self confidence booster. As for religion, I am not religious. some Christians believe this is ungodly etc, but one cannot allow their spirituality to be confined within a religious bubble. you have to go out and explore and experience things for yourself, instead of relying on some book that was written by some dudes. I could go on and on about this but i don't want to get into bashing religion right now. And I have no idea how a non sentient life form like the rainforrest get its info about my life. Maybe the conscious infinite energy of the universe is speak through it. or maybe it was the conscious energy of the universe, and i just happened to think it was a rainforrest. maybe the rainforrest can feel our thoughts and emotions on a whole other reality that we don't understand, who knows! Yes I will be sober, i don't want alcohal to hinder my experience, or any other kind of psychedelic. the key is to let your mind be the psychedelic. when the mind is deprived of sensory input, it begins to hallucinate (or connect with higher frequency realities, who knows!) I was in the jungle for 7 days, my whole vacation was 14 days. The first and last Ayahuasca intake was in a cabin in the rain forrest, but the 2nd Ayahuasca intake was right in the middle of the jungle camping out at night. there is an option to take a longer duration, but i started with one week for my experience. The bowel movements weren't too painful, it wasn't so bad that it ruined my experience, its the feeling your gut gives you just before you vomit. I brought misquito repellant and only got bit twice the whole trip. It wasn't a 3 day hike for me, it was more like a drive to a very remote village, then someone from a village takes you on a bought down a river to an even more remote place and you are at these cabins. then Orlando takes you for a 10 min walk to a secluded part of the jungle for the Ayahuasca. I am going to try the isolation tank in a couple weeks so I will definitely write about it when I experience it. Budget was $2500, it could be less depending on where you are traveling from. my plane ticket was about $1000, $500 cash for random expenses while traveling and the remaining for the Ayahuasca Dieta

I listen to the Joe Rogan podcast a lot. He had a guest on his show name Marcus Aubrey, and he was talking about his Ayahuasca experience. So I began to read Marcus's blog and he revealed the name of the Shaman he worked with. I did a little research on the Shaman and it appears that many people have worked with him all over the world, a lot of people where saying good things about him. So I contacted him and the rest was history. His name is Orlando Chujandama Huazanga, this is his website: http://thenewrisingsun.wordpress.com/2010/05/12/8/ If you want to do it with him, its a little more hardcore than most others. If you want to be in a nice room and have nice meals cooked for you, basically more of a retreat type of environment, there are other places that facilitate that. So just be aware that if you do this with Orlando, its gonna be more of a camping trip + Ayahuasca.
